descriptions.w3d_hud_visibility_8011ac1c: Updates two HUD resources according to visibility, engine state and the global suppression flag.
descriptions.w3d_hud_position_8011acf4: Copies a changed HUD position and invokes the virtual transform update when a backing resource exists.
descriptions.w3d_hud_properties_8011adf8: Copies two HUD properties and forwards both values to the held resource.
descriptions.w3d_hud_release_resources_8011af40: Releases both held HUD resources and clears their pointers.
descriptions.w3d_hud_set_visible_8011afac: Stores HUD visibility and applies it to both held resources when the first resource exists.
